# Common Network for Good Problems

I can help you troubleshoot issues with Network for Good. Here are the most common problems and solutions:

## **Donation Processing Issues**

- **Payment declined** - Check card details, billing address match, and sufficient funds
- **Duplicate donations** - Contact support immediately; don't resubmit
- **Receipt not received** - Check spam folder; receipts send automatically within 24 hours

## **Account Access Problems**

- **Can't log in** - Use password reset feature or clear browser cache/cookies
- **Account locked** - Contact support after multiple failed login attempts
- **Two-factor authentication issues** - Ensure correct time on your device

## **Reporting & Data Issues**

- **Missing donations in reports** - Check date filters and export settings
- **Donor data not syncing** - Verify integration settings with your CRM
- **Reconciliation errors** - Compare transaction IDs between platforms

## **Nonprofit-Specific Issues**

- **Funds not received** - Deposits typically process within 3-5 business days
- **Fee questions** - Review your pricing plan (typically 3-5% platform fee)
- **Campaign not appearing** - Check publication status and preview settings

## **Getting Help**

- **Support:** 1-888-284-7978 or support@networkforgood.com
- **Hours:** Monday-Friday, 9 AM - 8 PM ET
- **Help Center:** https://support.networkforgood.com

**What specific issue are you experiencing?** I can provide more targeted help if you share details.
